scenes.title: Mining and pursuit share the same space
lines: Here is another mining shot. The character approaches the golden deposits and mined pieces disappear.
Watch the pursuing enemies too. Moving toward minerals and away from danger takes place in the same space.

scenes.title: A destination still has nearby danger
lines: Now the character heads toward a marked circle. Watch the movement past the rocks and toward its edge.
Nearby enemies remain after the character enters. Reaching a destination and observing danger continue together.

scenes.title: Read the gap while watching pursuit
lines: This is a separate pursuit section. Rocks stand between the large green enemy and the character moving along a narrow route.
Watch the usable gap as well as the character. Familiar avoidance is accompanied by reading the terrain.
